title: State mapping preserves tape agreement
statement: Let $d$ and $d'$ be configurations with the same number of work tapes, symbol type, and input, possibly with different state types, and suppose their tapes agree outside position sets $F_j$. For any function $f$ from the state set of $d'$ to another state set, the tapes of $d$ and the configuration obtained from $d'$ by applying $f$ to its state still agree outside those sets.
hypotheses_covered: Configurations $d$ and $d'$ have the same number of work tapes, symbol type, and input
State types for $d$ and $d'$ may differ
A position set $F_j$ is specified for each work tape
The configurations' tapes agree outside their respective sets
A function from the state type of $d'$ to a state type
